entities.name: PMID:40434003
observations: Review reports asynchronous replication timing can induce false CNV calls in high-S-phase-ratio cells; replication-timing-domain correction reduces these calls.

entities.name: PMID:39614124
observations: Primary study notes DNA replication causes genomic read-count fluctuations in single-cell DNA sequencing; SPRINTER incorporates replication timing to identify S/G2 cells while inferring CNAs.

entities.name: S-phase read-depth artifacts
observations: In sequencing-based single-cell copy-number profiling, ongoing replication can create read-depth fluctuations that mimic CNVs; replication-timing correction may reduce false positives. Available evidence does not quantify missed true segmental events or establish effects for non-sequencing assays.
